name: aurora-bubble
title: Aurora Bubble
author: jmagar <https://github.com/jmagar>
description: Message presentation primitive with Aurora default, secondary, muted, tinted, outline, ghost, and destructive variants plus reaction positioning.
docs:
Aurora Bubble primitive for chat presentation. BubbleContent supports asChild through Radix Slot, while BubbleReactions positions compact reaction controls without coupling them to message data.

Registry dependencies: aurora-tokens, aurora-components.
